id.description: Record id of the patch, kebab-case, says what it does: add-contracts-in-left-menu

name.description: i18n name shown in the platform artifact list

target.description: ecos-apps artifact ref of the artifact being patched: <artifactType>$<localId>

workspace.description: Workspace id of the patched artifact; empty for a global artifact

order.description: Application order among the patches of one target; lower runs first

enabled.description: Disabled patches are ignored by the platform and revert their patched revision

type.description: The only patch type the platform applies to artifact content

path.description: JsonPath into the target's content, always starting with $. or $[ : $.subMenu.left.items, $.actions, $.associations[?(@.id == 'assoc:x')].journals

value.description: Value for add/set; an array value is appended element-wise by add

idx.description: Insert position for add; appended at the end when omitted

key.description: For set: the key to set inside the object(s) the path resolves to
